update.summary: Establish central versioned compiled TaviX application repository and ZipRunner Git-reviewed publication.

planned_work.title: Initial centralized Git-reviewed TaviX extension repository
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Create separate tavix ZipRunner project, stage Atrium and Companion compiled releases under root extensions/, validate immutable manifests/hashes and feed index; verify local tests; operator review and push separate.

planned_work.title: Connect published static TaviX repository to Tavi App Store
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: After Git-reviewed push enable Pages and confirm HTTPS public index/assets/CORS, then subscribe on Windows/Android/web and check consented install/update/source transitions.

done_work.summary: Source candidate includes deterministic package tooling, no-Git staging, immutable release index, initial Atrium 1.0.2 and Companion 0.6.30 compiled assets, Pages workflow, and regression tests.

evidence.description: Verified output staged under versioned extensions paths
Collision, tamper, index and multi-version regression checks

todo_work.next_action: Import ZipRunner package, inspect source/compiled assets and live Git diff; push only after operator approval.
Enable GitHub Actions Pages and connect Tavi App Store to the central HTTPS index; validate installed publisher/source transitions.

checks.description: Local Python validator + staging test suite
checks.command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v && python tools/repository.py check --repository .
checks.environment: Linux Python 3.13 with supplied Atrium/Companion compiled extension assets

checks.description: Windows ZipRunner build and Git repository binding
Actual GitHub Pages deployment, HTTPS/CORS, Tavi Windows/Android installation
checks.reason: Requires operator-approved Git push and live clients.

handover.next_pass: Operator review/push the new TaviX project, then migrate Tavi first-party subscription and host generic Atrium->Life launch.
risks: Companion source 0.6.30 was not provided; initial candidate uses compiled bundle only.
Published static Tavi extension assets are not signed by a separate publisher signing root.
Tavi 0.3.108 has an older Atrium first-party repo; explicitly accept new source and avoid implicit migration.
notes: The TaviX ZipRunner checkout is intended to be adjacent to Atrium and Companion; scripts do not invoke Git.

operator_actions.description: Create a new ZipRunner project with key tavix, bind exact GitHub remote and import the attached ZIP.
Review diff and push with existing ZipRunner Git controls only after approving staged assets and licenses.
Enable GitHub Pages GitHub Actions source for tavix, confirm public index and subscribe with user consent.

release.notes: Source/compiled distribution staging only; not a published release.
